id_candidates_sample: The preset can be cinematic; the route budget decides how much of it is allowed to show.
Never put G5/R3F/physical glass in routine dense tables.
Never put strong glow in more than one primary CTA per viewport.
Never animate background faster than the user can ignore.
Never use hydro rim on every card.
Never make the AppShell itself a hero card.
Gallery is lab. Materiality Catalog is contract. Governor is enforcement. Chart Lab is workshop. Apps are consumers.
Every preset exposes tunable knobs as variables/tokens.
Random local tokens create visual contraband.
Use for spacing, grid spans, states and arbitrary CSS variables; never as random color soup.
Utility sprawl without recipes becomes digital confetti.
Dialogs, tooltips, popovers, dropdowns, select, tabs, accordion, alert dialogs.
Styling Radix without respecting focus/aria throws away the good part.
Use as structural seed, then skin with PRISMA recipes.
Leaving default shadcn look unskinned breaks identity.
Every major component gets material/tone/density/surface variants.
Manual class concatenation becomes a cursed enchilada.
Microinteraction layer: cards, buttons, nav, command palette, drawers, tabs.
Long ambient timelines are better in GSAP.
Background drift, hero intro, tours, demo mode, premium route transitions.
Do not GSAP every hover, hermano.
Hydro rim pseudo-elements, not text containers.
Applying displacement to content makes text look drunk.
Landing, splash, chart lab wow stage, rare hero objects.
If it appears on CRUD, alguien se emocionó demasiado.
Charts, insights, chart lab, visual investigations, hotspots.
Default table styling or too much glass kills readability.
Settings, filters, bulk actions, create/edit flows, validation contracts.
Visual beauty cannot hide bad validation copy.
Transient success/warning/loading/error with PRISMA glass shell.
Do not toast every tiny state change.
Global launcher, route search, quick actions, entity lookup.
A command palette without ranking is a junk drawer.
Mobile/tablet bottom sheets, evidence drawers, action drawers.
Desktop side panels still need desktop rhythm.
Chart Lab, comparison mode, audit studios, data workspaces.
Resizable everything turns the app into a cockpit garage sale.
All component icons with strict sizing and stroke discipline.
Icon-only navigation without tooltip/label creates mystery meat.
Filters, reports, audit and KPI date windows.
Raw timestamps visible by default are UI crimes.
Theme/skin switching, reduced visual intensity modes, future light/dark families.
Theme switching without component tokens causes Frankenstyles.

philosophy.core: Maximum visual expression, but parameterized and governable. Pasado de lanza en presets, no pasado de lanza en cada screen.
philosophy.principle: The preset can be cinematic; the route budget decides how much of it is allowed to show.
philosophy.translation: La receta puede traer turbo, alerón y luces debajo del carro; la pantalla decide si va en modo valet o modo pista.
hard_limits: Never put G5/R3F/physical glass in routine dense tables.
Never put strong glow in more than one primary CTA per viewport.
Never animate background faster than the user can ignore.
Never use hydro rim on every card.
Never make the AppShell itself a hero card.
